text:
**Answer: A. Clostridium difficile.** My earlier answer of Salmonella was wrong. Diarrhea after repeated antibiotic courses points to C. difficile overgrowth, which fits the history better than any of the other options. I'm not fully comfortable with the hektoen agar detail, since it normally selects for Salmonella and Shigella, but Giardia is the only other option the team note allows and it has no link to antibiotic use.

CONFIDENCE: 80
